stem: Kelly wants to add a more effective transition between the second paragraph (sentences 4–11) and the third paragraph (sentences 12–14). Which of the following sentences should be added before sentence 12 to help readers effectively transition from the second to the third paragraph?

options.label: F
options.text: Using the snooze button can have a negative impact on a person’s health.

options.label: G
options.text: Perhaps more serious, though, is how this sleepiness can affect a person’s mood.

options.label: H
options.text: Sleepiness also may occur if the body’s circadian rhythm, or internal body clock, is disrupted.

options.label: J
options.text: Interfering with the natural circadian rhythms is equally distracting.
